title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10
lineage: Anne Cohen : AD Transfer - Master Cassettes played on Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR830Plus > CD Ohr : CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones > Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck (1st & 2nd Sets: Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes), Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Spectacular OHR matrix capture with perfect instrument balance; the show is hailed as a five‑star, high‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its flawless balance and crystal‑clear reproduction of guitars and drums, reflecting the live sound faithfully. Reviewers also rave that the concert itself was outstanding, deserving five stars all day long, indicating an energetic and memorable performance.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both exceptional show energy and excellent recording quality, leading to a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Perfect balance; true to the tone of guitars and drums as heard from the speakers; no reported flaws.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone praised as true to the live sound.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sound noted for its accurate, balanced reproduction.
